from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from pathlib import Path
import os
p=Path(os.environ['TMPDIR'])/'jvwu-academics.html'

for panel in s.select('.panel.panel-default'):
    h=panel.select_one('h3.panel-title, h3.panel-title.panel-top')
    if not h: continue
    a=h.find('a')
    if not a: continue
    title=' '.join(''.join(a.find_all(string=True, recursive=False)).split())
    level=''
    spans=a.find_all('span', recursive=False)
    if spans: level=' '.join(spans[0].get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
    body=panel.select_one('.course-detail')
    vals={}
    if body:
        for li in body.select('li'):
            lab=li.select_one('.title')
            if not lab: continue
            label=' '.join(lab.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
            txt=' '.join(li.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
            if label in ('Discipline','Eligibility','Duration','Regular Mode (Only for Female)','External Mode (Both for Male & Female)'):
                vals[label]=txt[len(label):].strip()

        q=a.get('href','')
        print(f\"{panel.get('id','')}\\t{title}\\t{level}\\t{q}\\t{vals}\")
PY"

    h=panel.select_one('h3.panel-title, h3.panel-title.panel-top'); a=h.find('a') if h else None
    if not a: continue
    title=' '.join(''.join(a.find_all(string=True,recursive=False)).split())
    spans=a.find_all('span',recursive=False)
    level=' '.join(spans[0].get_text(' ',strip=True).split()) if spans else ''
    vals={}
    for li in panel.select('.course-detail li'):
        lab=li.select_one('.title')
        if not lab: continue
        label=' '.join(lab.get_text(' ',strip=True).split()); txt=' '.join(li.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
        if label in ('Discipline','Eligibility','Duration','Regular Mode (Only for Female)','External Mode (Both for Male & Female)'):
            vals[label]=txt[len(label):].strip()
    if vals.get('Discipline') not in ('Law & Governance','Pharmacy'): continue
    m=re.search(r\"getcoursevalue\\('(["'^'"']+)'\",str(panel))
    if m: raw.append({'id':m.group(1),'name':title,'official_level':level,**vals})

# Preserve every exact official catalogue row here; the 11 entries have unique IDs.
con=sqlite3.connect('file:assets/data/career_path.db?mode=ro',uri=True)
nodes={r[0]:{'slug':r[1],'name':r[2],'parent_id':r[3],'stream_id':r[4]} for r in con.execute('select id,slug,name,parent_id,stream_id from career_nodes')}
streams={r[0]:r[2] for r in con.execute('select id,slug,name,intro from streams')}
def breadcrumb(i):
    n=nodes[i]; chain=[]; j=i
    while j is not None: chain.append(nodes[j]['name']); j=nodes[j]['parent_id']
    return ' > '.join([streams[n['stream_id']]]+list(reversed(chain)))
def mp(i,relation,confidence,status='reviewed_against_local_tree'):
    return {'career_node_id':i,'career_node_slug':nodes[i]['slug'],'career_breadcrumb':breadcrumb(i),'relation':relation,'confidence':confidence,'mapping_status':status}
def maps(t):
    if t.startswith('BA-LLB'): return [mp(63,'direct_programme','high')]
    if t.startswith('BBA-LLB'): return [mp(50,'direct_programme','high')]
    if t.startswith('B.com -LLB'): return [mp(51,'direct_programme','high')]
    if t.startswith('LLB -'): return [mp(343,'nearest_parent','medium')]
    if t.startswith('LLM'): return [mp(343,'nearest_parent','medium'),mp(218,'closest_specialization','medium'),mp(255,'closest_specialization','medium')]
    if t.startswith('B.Pharm'): return [mp(20,'direct_programme_slug','high','reviewed_with_career_tree_label_issue')]
    if t.startswith('M.Pharm'): return [mp(144,'closest_specialization','medium')]
    if t.startswith('Ph.D in Pharmacy'): return [mp(144,'closest_specialization','high')]
    if t.startswith('Ph.D in Law'): return [mp(343,'nearest_parent','medium')]
    return []
def level(l):
    if 'Ph.D' in l: return 'Ph.D'
    if l.startswith('UG'): return 'UG'
    if l.startswith('PG'): return 'PG'
    return l
def credential(l):
    if 'Ph.D' in l: return 'Doctoral degree'
    if l.startswith('UG'): return \"Bachelor's degree\"
    if l.startswith('PG'): return \"Master's degree\"
    return None
courses=[]
for r in raw:
    L=level(r['official_level']); t=r['name']; mapping=maps(t)
    duration=r.get('Duration') or None
    # Official category pages disagree on LLM duration (1 year vs central catalogue 2 years).
    if t.startswith('LLM'): duration=None
    if not duration and (r.get('Regular Mode (Only for Female)') or r.get('External Mode (Both for Male & Female)')):
        duration='; '.join(x for x in [
            ('Regular mode (female only): '+r['Regular Mode (Only for Female)']) if r.get('Regular Mode (Only for Female)') else '',
            ('External mode (male and female): '+r['External Mode (Both for Male & Female)']) if r.get('External Mode (Both for Male & Female)') else ''
        ] if x)
    spec=None
    if t.startswith('M.Pharm'): spec='Pharmacology' if 'Pharmacology' in t else 'Pharmaceutics'
    if t.startswith('LLM'): spec='Corporate / Criminal Law'
    courses.append({'course_id':r['id'],'name':t,'level':L,'credential':credential(r['official_level']),'specialization':spec,'duration':duration,'mode':'Research' if L=='Ph.D' else 'Regular','eligibility':r.get('Eligibility') or None,'official_course_url':'https://www.jvwu.ac.in/academics','verification_status':'verified','career_path_mappings':mapping,'mapping_gap':None})
